name: create
body:
Range("A1").Value = 1
Range("B1").Value = 2
ThisWorkbook.Names.Add "TestName", "=Sheet1!$A$1"
Range("C1").Formula = "=TestName"
answer = CStr(Range("C1").Value)
answer = ""
On Error Resume Next
Set nm = ThisWorkbook.Names.Add(Name:="TestName", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1", Visible:=False)
answer = nm.Name & ":" & nm.RefersTo & ":" & CStr(nm.Visible)
n = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Report = CStr(n) & "|" & answer & "|" & CStr(ThisWorkbook.Names.Count)
